efficacy.model: Mouse collagen-induced arthritis (DBA/1J) dosed with tirabrutinib (ONO-4059)
efficacy.note: Mouse CIA efficacy led Ono to call for clinical testing in inflammatory disease; tirabrutinib 40 mg missed the week-12 composite primary in Sjogren (34.7% vs 26.7%, P=0.33).
efficacy.quote: Three drugs with disparate mechanisms were tested, but no significant differences vs placebo in primary or secondary end points were observed.
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level. Model side (Ariza 2019, J Mol Sci, iMedPub) has no DOI or PMID, so tier 1 for model_src is contested; cross-disease model (RA arthritis model for a Sjogren trial).
efficacy.judgement: Paired by me: CIA efficacy (predicting benefit) vs the NCT03100942 primary. Year is the registry results posting (2020-01-22). Contra, not untested: the 40 mg arm was dosed and completed, so the miss is efficacy.
efficacy.magnitude_basis: week-12 composite responder rate, tirabrutinib 34.7% vs placebo 26.7% (P=0.33)
efficacy.population: Unselected (active primary or secondary Sjogren syndrome, ESSDAI >= 5)

patient_trials.quote: At week 12, 43.3% of the filgotinib group achieved the primary end point (P = 0.17 vs placebo) vs 42.3% (P = 0.16), 34.7% (P = 0.33), and 26.7% of lanraplenib, tirabrutinib, and placebo groups, respectively.

considered_not_added: Tirabrutinib TNP-Ficoll mouse (Ariza 2019): showed once-daily dosing did not give continuous B-cell BTK inhibition, but stated no human exposure or occupancy target, and the same paper found once daily sufficient in CIA; no checkable human dose prediction, and no Sjogren occupancy was measured (draft's tirabrutinib-pkpd-occupancy track already covers dose).

BMS-986142 rat/dog toxicology: RA phase 2 dropped the 350 mg arm for elevated liver enzymes (Lancet Rheumatol 2023, PMID 38251590), but no BMS-986142 nonclinical toxicology is public (Lee 2017 full text not retrieved), so no comparison can be made; a track would be untested/unpublished only.

Remibrutinib PBPK model (NDA 218436 review section 14.5.3): built and verified on clinical PK and used for CYP3A DDI labeling, not for a Sjogren dose, efficacy or safety prediction; retrodictive PK only, outside the four questions.
Sjogren-specific animal models (NOD, IL-14alpha transgenic, sialadenitis) dosed with a member drug: none found for remibrutinib, tirabrutinib or BMS-986142.
Patient-derived cells, ex-vivo salivary gland, organoid, human challenge or genetic models (XLA) compared with Sjogren BTK-inhibitor outcomes: none found.
BMS-986142 human in-vitro B-cell assays (Gillooly 2017): already inside the draft's mouse-cia-caia-bms986142 track (checker flagged the lumping as a rule question, not a missing system).
